output.reason: The release note [ev-2c984df9c0e9] is only a one-line title. The linked PR [ev-ee7a4ed528ad] adds that the conversion sits behind a beta feature flag that is off by default "for now", depends on PRs #6636 and #6624, and adds CRD Get/List/Watch RBAC to provider roles (the text is cut off). It does not name the flag, say whether it is still off in the 2.0.0 release, or say what conversion does to an existing provider's CRDs. The changed-files list [ev-6f0a3f0f7449] shows edits to the Helm values and core.go but not the flag key. Related later items in the same section, such as moving the CRD view RBAC [ev-67a96855ff1b] and merging existing MRDs [ev-cd857bf3470c], suggest the behaviour changed again before release. So the subject, the release-time default, who is exposed and the consequence can't be pinned down from what is shown.
